subject: Mental Models
title: Flywheel Effect
description: A short lesson to help you apply Flywheel Effect.

hook.text: Amazon loses money on free shipping.

buildup.text: A flywheel is a self-reinforcing loop where each component accelerates the next.

discovery.text: Jim Collins described the flywheel in Good to Great.

twist.text: The flywheel's strength is patience. Most people abandon it before momentum builds.

punchline.text: Consistent small pushes create unstoppable momentum.

quiz.question: Who described the flywheel effect in Good to Great?
